source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cell-mediated and antibody-mediated immunity (PDF 177-182).

blocks.text: Hum parh chuke hain ke jab microbes jism par hamla karte hain to macrophages unhein nigal kar foran jawab dete hain. Yeh jawab bohat se microbes ko khatam nahin kar sakta, lekin immune system (difa ki teesri line) ko jawab dene ka waqt de deta hai.

Jab macrophage kisi microbe ko nigalta hai to woh helper T cells ke liye khaas proteins bhi banata hai. Jab helper T cells apne receptors ke zariye in proteins ko pehchante hain to woh fa'al (activate) ho jate hain. Fa'al helper T cells do mutawazi (parallel, saath saath chalne wale) immune responses shuru karte hain: cell-mediated immunity aur antibody-mediated immunity.
1. Cell-mediated immunity

Cell-mediated immunity T cells anjaam dete hain. Yeh ghair maamooli (abnormal) ya virus-infected cells ko maar kar jism ko virus infections aur cancer se bachati hai. Is mein cytotoxic T cells infected jismani cells ko pehchan kar tabah karte hain. In ka maarne ka tareeqa natural killer cells jaisa hai, yaani yeh target cells (infected cells ya ghair maamooli cancer cells) ki membranes mein soorakh kar dete hain. Cell-mediated immunity ke ahem waqiyat yeh hain:

items: Proliferation (tadaad barhna): Fa'al helper T cell ghulne wale (soluble) chemicals banata hai, maslan T cell growth factor. Yeh factor har qism ke T cells ki tadaad barhana shuru kar deta hai, aur antigens pehchanne wale T cells ke bare clones (aik jaise cells ke groups) ban jate hain.
Activation: Fa'al helper T cell aik doosra factor chhorta hai jo macrophages ko infection ki jagah khench lata hai.
Induction: Helper T cells thymus mein inducer T cells ko fa'al karte hain, jo lymphocytes ko T cells mein pukhta (mature) karna shuru karte hain.

Attack (hamla): Cytotoxic T cells ki satah par maujood receptors infected jismani cells ko pehchante hain, is liye yeh T cells infected cells se chipak jate hain. Yeh infected cells ki membrane tor dete hain aur cells phat jate hain.

Suppression (rokna): Suppressor T cells cytotoxic T cells ka jawab rok dete hain. Suppressor T cells ki tadaad cytotoxic T cells se ahista barhti hai. Shuru mein in ki kam tadaad ki wajah se yeh cytotoxic hamle ko nahin rok pate. Lekin 1 se 2 hafton ke baad in ki tadaad itni ho jati hai ke yeh cytotoxic T cells ka jawab band kar dete hain.

Memory (yaad): Suppression ke baad T cells ki aik aabadi baqi reh jati hai, shayad insaan ki poori umr ke liye. Yeh helper aur cytotoxic T cells ab memory cells kehlate hain. Agar wahi microbe dobara aaye to yeh foran tez jawab dete hain.

blocks.alt: Shaakhon wala silsila. Macrophage ke banaye proteins helper T-cell mein waqiyat shuru karte; yeh activated helper T-cell ban kar ghulne wale maadde (soluble factors) chhorta. Teen shaakhein: macrophage ko infected cell ki taraf khenchna; T-cells ki afzaish; aur inducer T-cell jis se lymphocytes T-cells mein pukhta hote. Barhe hue T-cells se cytotoxic T-cells (infected cell par hamla), suppressor T-cells (jawab rokna) aur memory cells (aainda ke liye) bante.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sab kuch macrophage se shuru hota hai: us ke proteins helper T-cell ko fa'al karte hain. Fa'al helper T-cell ke soluble factors teen kaam karte hain: macrophage ko infected cell ki taraf bulate hain, T-cells ki tadaad barhate hain, aur inducer T-cell ke zariye naye T-cells pukhta karwate hain. Barhe hue T-cells teen kaam baant lete hain: cytotoxic (maarna), suppressor (rokna) aur memory (yaad rakhna).
2. Antibody-mediated immunity

Jab helper T cell fa'al hota hai to woh sirf cell-mediated immunity ko hi fa'al nahin karta, balke aik doosra, zyada taqatwar difa bhi shuru karta hai jise antibody-mediated ya humoral immunity kehte hain. Is immunity ke asal khiladi B cells hain. Yeh antigens par seedha hamla nahin karte, balke un par tabahi ka nishan laga dete hain. Yeh zehreele (toxic) molecules ko bhi bekaar (inactivate) kar dete hain. Antibody-mediated immunity ke ahem waqiyat yeh hain:

Proliferation: Har B cell apni satah par maujood B receptor proteins ke zariye antigens se jur jata hai. Helper T cells aise antigen se jure B cells ko pehchan kar un se chipak jate hain. Phir helper T cells aise proteins chhorte hain jo B cell ko taqseem hone par uksate hain. Nateeje mein har B cell se bohat bari tadaad mein cells bante hain jinhein plasma cells kehte hain.
Khoon ke plasma ke kul protein ka wazan ke lehaz se taqreeban 20% antibodies hain.

Differentiation aur Secretion: Zyada tar plasma cells taqseem hona chhor kar mazeed B receptor proteins banana shuru kar dete hain. Yeh B receptor proteins cell se bahar chhore (secrete) jate hain aur ab inhein antibodies kehte hain. Plasma cells sirf chand dinon mein bohat bari tadaad mein antibodies chhor dete hain.
Vaccine antibodies banwati hai aur memory cells banane mein madad deti hai. Vaccines maare hue ya kamzor kiye gaye pathogens se banti hain jo jism mein antibodies banwate hain.
blocks.title: Vaccine

blocks.text: Attack: Antibodies antigen ko seedha tabah nahin karti, balke teen tareeqon mein se kisi aik se us par tabahi ka nishan lagati hain:

items: Complement: Kuch antibodies antigen se jurne ke baad complement system ke proteins ko fa'al karti hain. Yeh proteins antibody se lipte antigen ki membrane mein ghus kar soorakh kar dete hain. Paani antigen cell mein khinch aata hai, aur woh phool kar phat jata hai.
Macrophages: Kuch antibodies jab antigen se jur jati hain to macrophage unhein pehchan kar antigen ko nigal leta aur tor deta hai.

Killer cells: Killer cells natural killer cells jaise hote hain, farq yeh hai ke in mein aise receptors hote hain jo antibody se lipte antigens ko pehchante hain. Jab killer cell ko antibody se lipta antigen milta hai to woh us se jur kar us cell ko maar deta hai.

blocks.text: Malignant melanoma skin ka jaan lewa cancer hai. Aik khaas qism ka WBC, tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL), aam taur par cancer ki rasoli (tumour) par hamla karta hai, lekin itna taqatwar nahin hota ke rasoli ko qaboo kar sake. Genetic engineers koshish kar rahe hain ke TIL mein aisa gene dalein jis se TIL tumour necrosis factor (TNF) naam ka protein bana sake. Yeh protein rasoli ke cells ko maar deta hai. Jab genetically engineered TIL mareez ke khoon mein wapas dale jayenge to woh rasoli mein ja kar TNF banayenge aur use khatam karenge.
blocks.title: Immune System aur Gene Therapy

blocks.text: Suppression: Kai hafton ke baad suppressor T cells antibody response ko band kar dete hain.

Memory: Fa'al B cells ke clone ke kuch cells plasma cells nahin bante aur antibodies nahin banate. Is ke bajaye yeh memory B cells ban kar baqi reh jate hain. Agar wahi antigen dobara aaye to yeh tez secondary response (doosra jawab) dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke memory B cells 'plasma cells ke clone' ke un cells se bante hain jo antibodies nahin banate. Yeh sahi nahin: plasma cell aakhri darje ka cell hai jo sirf antibodies banata hai. Antigen se fa'al hone wale B cell ka clone do qism ke cells deta hai: plasma cells (antibodies banane wale) aur memory B cells. Is liye upar 'fa'al B cells ka clone' likha gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Primary response: antigen aik munasib B cell ke B receptor proteins se jurte; helper T cell is se jurta aur afzaish se plasma cells bante jo antibody molecules chhorte, aur aik memory B cell. Usi antigen se dobara saamna: secondary response, jis mein memory B cell bohat zyada plasma cells, kahin zyada antibodies aur naye memory B cells deta.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehli dafa (primary response) thore plasma cells aur antibodies bante hain, magar memory B cell bhi banta hai. Usi antigen se doosri dafa saamna ho (secondary response) to yahi memory B cell foran bohat zyada plasma cells aur antibodies banata hai; isi liye doosra jawab tez aur taqatwar hota hai.
Antibody ki banawat (Structure of Antibody)

Antibody Y shakal ka protein hai. Yeh chaar polypeptide chains se bani hai: do aik jaisi lambi (heavy) chains aur do chhoti (light) chains. Chaaron chains disulfide bridges (pulon) se aapas mein jori hoti hain. Har chain ka aik constant region hota hai (aik hi class ki tamam antibodies mein milta julta) aur aik variable region (jo har antibody mein mukhtalif hota hai). Y ke har baazu mein aik heavy aur aik light chain ke variable regions mil kar aik khaas binding site (jurne ki jagah) banate hain. Mukhtalif antibodies ke variable regions mukhtalif hote hain. Isi liye antibodies specific hoti hain, yaani sirf usi khaas antigen ki tabahi ka sabab banti hain jis ne unhein banwaya tha.

blocks.alt: Y shakal ki antibody. Do heavy chains tana aur har baazu ka andaruni hissa banati hain; har baazu ke bairooni taraf aik light chain. Har chain ka sira variable region (sabz) hai, baqi constant region (narangi). Disulfide pul dono heavy chains ko aur har light chain ko us ki heavy chain se jorte hain. Bracket dono baazuon ke siron par binding sites dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.14: Antibody ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 21.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Monoclonal Antibodies

Antigen molecule ka sirf aik chhota hissa antibody ki binding site mein fit hota hai. Is hisse ko determinant kehte hain. Kuch soorton mein bohat si mukhtalif antibodies aik hi antigen se jur sakti hain; har antibody antigen ki satah ke alag hisse mein fit hoti hai. Is qism ki antibody ko polyclonal antibody kehte hain.

Doosri taraf kuch antibodies sirf aik hi determinant se jurti hain. Inhein monoclonal antibodies kehte hain. 1984 mein Cesar Milstein aur Georges Köhler (kitab mein 'George Kohler') ko monoclonal antibody banane ka tareeqa maloom karne par Nobel Prize diya gaya. Apne tajurbe mein unhon ne antibodies banane wale plasma cells ko cancer cells, jinhein myelomas kehte hain, ke saath milaya. Unhein culture mein kuch naye cells barhte aur taqseem hote nazar aaye. Yeh cells, jinhein hybridomas kehte hain, antibodies banane ke liye plasma cell ke genes aur barhne aur taqseem hone ke liye myeloma ke genes istemal karte the. Hybridoma cells wahi antibody banate rahe jis ke liye un ka plasma cell khaas (specialized) tha. Is tarah unhein tezi se barhne wale hybridoma cells mile jo monoclonal antibodies bana rahe the.

blocks.alt: Choohe mein antigen ka teeka, us ki tilli se plasma cells (B cells). Cancer cells (myelomas) culture mein ugaye jate. Dono test tube mein milaye jate jahan cells jur kar hybridomas bante, aur hybridoma culture monoclonal antibodies banata.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.15: Monoclonal antibodies (kitab ki Figure 21.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Antigen injected into mouse, Plasma cells (B cells) from spleen, Cancer cells (myelomas) grown in culture, Cells fused to produce hybridomas, Hybridoma cell culture producing monoclonal antibodies.

blocks.text: Monoclonal antibodies bohat ahem sabit hui hain kyun ke in se paicheeda mixtures mein se khaas molecules alag kar ke saaf (purify) kiye ja sakte hain. Interferon isi tarah saaf kiya gaya tha. Medicine mein monoclonal antibodies khaas ilaaj ko sahi jagah pohanchane ki sawari (vehicle) ke taur par istemal hoti hain. Aise antigens par research jaari hai jo sirf cancer cells par hote hain, taa ke radioactive monoclonal antibodies ko un par nishana bana kar sirf cancer cells ko maara ja sake.

blocks.prompt: Vaccine saalon tak kyun bachati hai, jab ke bani banayi di gayi antibodies thori der?
blocks.explanation: Vaccine jism se uske apne memory B aur T cells banwati hai jo baad mein infection par foran tez jawab dete hain. Di gayi antibodies kuch arse mein khatam ho jati hain aur un se memory cells nahin bante.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Macrophage ke proteins helper T cells ko fa'al karte hain jo cell-mediated aur antibody-mediated immunity shuru karte hain.
Cell-mediated (T cells): proliferation, activation, induction, attack, suppression (1-2 hafte baad), memory.
Antibody-mediated (B cells): proliferation se plasma cells, antibodies ka secretion, attack (complement, macrophages, killer cells), suppression, memory B cells.
Antibody: Y shakal, 2 heavy + 2 light chains, disulfide bridges, variable regions binding site banate hain.
Monoclonal antibodies: aik determinant; plasma cell + myeloma = hybridoma (Milstein aur Köhler, 1984).
